0022600211.text: The Bucks (1-8, 15th in the East, on a five-game losing streak) are 0-4 on the road and visit the Knicks (5-4, 5th in the East, on a three-game winning streak). The teams have not met yet this season, and New York won the last meeting 127-98 in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026, after Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 series 1-2. Milwaukee will be without Gary Trent Jr., who is out with illness, while New York's Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision.
